Method of Attack: Ransomware installed using a DLL executed by Rundll32.exe
Encrypts targeted file types appending .shit extension
Distributed through SPAM emails with attachments (HTA, JS, WSF) that download encrypted DLL installer
Decrypts and executes DLL on victim's computer
Encrypts over 380 file extensions using AES encryption
Displays ransom notes with payment instructions named _WHAT_is.html, _[2_digit_number]_WHAT_is.html, and _WHAT_is.bmp
Attack Vector: SPAM emails with subject line Receipt ###-### containing malicious attachments (HTA, JS, WSF)
